Gulfshore Playhouse presents A Christmas Carol, adapted and directed by Kristen Coury, on the Moran Mainstage at the Baker Theatre and Education Center, 100 Goodlette-Frank Road South, Naples. Previews are Nov 17, 18, and 19; opening night is Friday, Nov 20 at 7:30 PM; Saturday, Nov 21 has performances at 2:00 PM and 7:30 PM; the final performance is Dec 24. The production features live music, dancing, and Dickens’ story of Scrooge’s journey through Christmases past, present, and future. Tickets are sold through Gulfshore Playhouse.

What's happening

The 22nd Annual Iron Joe Turkey Ride & Walk is Sunday, Nov 22, at Eagle Lakes Community Park, 11565 Tamiami Trail E, Naples. Official family-friendly starts are the 5-mile inside-the-park ride at 10:05 AM and the 2.5- or 5-mile walk at 10:10 AM. Longer rides start earlier (62-mile 8:00 AM, 40-mile 8:30 AM, 20-mile 9:30 AM, 10-mile 10:00 AM). Breakfast is offered before the rides; lunch by Jason’s Deli follows. Children 12 and under may ride or walk free with a paid adult on the 5- and 10-mile bike routes and the walking routes. Helmets and closed-toe shoes are required for every rider. Register at runsignup.com/Race/FL/Naples/IronJoeTurkeyRide. Packet pickup is Saturday, Nov 21, 11 AM–1 PM at Jason’s Deli, 2700 Immokalee Rd.
